connector.name: Synapse Network MCP Server for paid API calls
connector.registryDescription: Synapse Network MCP paid API calls via discover_services; not Synapse.org/Sage Bionetworks Synapse.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.synapse-network.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the synapsenetworkai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer SynapseNetwork Agent Key beginning with agt_. Example: Bearer agt_xxx. Used by the Remote MCP layer and mapped to Gateway X-Credential.

env.name: SYNAPSE_AGENT_KEY
env.description: SynapseNetwork Agent Key beginning with agt_. Used as the Gateway X-Credential header.

env.name: SYNAPSE_ENV
env.description: Gateway environment preset: prod or staging. Use prod for production workflows; staging is for preview and E2E validation.

env.name: SYNAPSE_GATEWAY_URL
env.description: Optional custom Gateway base URL. Overrides SYNAPSE_ENV.
